text:
ana (partnerships): @marcus :wave: quick sync — NordCloudPartners and StratusWorks asked to onboard a Baltic region (eu-baltic1) into the marketplace + reserved capacity. Can we list the gating items and timelines?
marcus (NordCloudPartners): Thanks Ana. Our partner asks for 4x A100-equivalent GPUs initially, marketplace entitlement, and KMS-integrated key flow. Targeting GA in ~6 weeks if approvals are fast.
vikram (sales): Heads up: we promised regional pricing sheet and joint announcement slot with marketing. Need legal signoff before PR. :calendar:
julia (ops): Ops checklist: SKU provisioning, quota requests (cloud provider), network peering for private deployment, and capacity burst policy. I need the exact SKU codes from partner / cloud seller to open tickets.
kevin (infra): For infra we'll need the AMI/container image fingerprint and quantization profile to pre-build inference images. Also confirm whether KV cache persistence is ok across AZs in eu-baltic1.
sami (StratusWorks SI): From SI side we'll handle on-prem connectivity playbooks and assist with KMS integration (we've done this for eu-north). Can provide a runbook template by EOD.
marta (legal): Two things: marketplace T&Cs + data residency addendum. Partner MSA draft is almost ready but need partner legal contact to accelerate.
marcus (NordCloudPartners): Partner legal is olga@nordcloudpartners.com. SKUs: NCP-BALT-A100x4, NCP-BALT-NODE-16TB. Also need a private tenancy option for regulated customers.
julia (ops): Opening quota ticket now. Ticket link: https://cloudtickets.example/REQ-8921 — adding @kevin and @sami. Please paste any missing SKUs into the ticket.
kevin (infra): Noted. For KMS we support AWS KMS and customer-managed HSM — confirm if partner requires HSM-backed keys or CMKs.
marcus (NordCloudPartners): Initially CMKs via AWS KMS, potential HSM later. Also want token-level billing visible in console for partner customers.
ana (partnerships): Action items: 1) julia open quota + ops ticket (in progress) 2) kevin infra to validate KV cache & image prebuild (due +3d) 3) marta legal to send MSA + data addendum to olga (due +5d) 4) sami to share SI runbook (EOD) 5) vikram coordinate marketing joint-announcement window (tentative week 7). I'll track in the launch doc.
sami (StratusWorks SI): Sharing runbook draft now: ```Network peering checklist
- VPC CIDR plan
- Peering & NAT
- KMS key rotation notes
- IPV6 considerations```
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline note: "eu-baltic1 prebuild jobs queued: 4 images" — logs: https://ci.example/eo/1123
vikram (sales): Marketing wants a 2-week notice before PR. If legal signs off in 5 days we're still on track. Also need partner logo + case blurb from Marcus.
marta (legal): Sent MSA PDF to olga@nordcloudpartners.com. Waiting confirmation.
marcus (NordCloudPartners): Received MSA, will review and come back with minor edits.
julia (ops): Quota ticket updated with SKUs and expected QPS: 1500 rps peak, 300 avg. Added KMS CMK request.
ana (partnerships): Great — I'll set up a brief Huddle tomorrow 09:30 UTC to close open blockers. If any blocker arises ping me directly. :thumbsup:
